ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the tax table. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The name of the tax table, referenced by table-based tax rules.

Version.description: Ignored on import: each site stamps its own version, incremented on every change.

EffectiveFromUtc.description: The UTC date the tax table stops being effective.

EffectiveToUtc.description: The UTC date the tax table stops being effective.

Minimum.description: The inclusive lower bound the row applies to.

Maximum.description: The exclusive upper bound the row applies to. Omit for no upper bound.

Rate.description: The rate applied within the row, expressed as a fraction (for example 0.2 for 20%).

FixedAmount.description: A fixed amount applied within the row.

BaseAmount.description: A base amount added before the rate is applied, used by tiered schedules.

Rows.description: The rows that make up the tax table.

TaxTables.description: The tax tables to create or update.
